title: SAME DAY, DIFFERENT RECORDS
scope_and_limits: An Apollo11 launch-day selection: original public-affairs commentary, two separately situated NASA stills dated16July1969, and a capsule-recovery still dated24July. No matching instants or image-audio synchronization asserted. Four-second audio fragment repeated four times with explicit editorial labels; not a word-timed verified phrase. Blank is scoped to absence of spacecraft-cabin views in these two selected photographs, not to the Launch Control Center interior and not to a missing historical event. V02 restores source hyphen in the four-word published quote and clarifies the cabin scope. No forced discrepancy, sponsor or commercial-broadcast context invented. Audition/precise phrase alignment remain pending.
reference_lineage: Bruce Conner, REPORT (1963–67), a construction around the mediated Kennedy assassination; institutional accounts emphasize news representation and consumer spectacle.
reference_inspection: Creator/institutional descriptions inspected on MoMA, Generali, AFI and BFI for this batch; no full reference-film viewing, close formal fidelity or reference-stronger verdict claimed. Other operator reference URLs retained as provided, not silently claimed newly opened.
archive_foraging: MovingImageArchive per-prompt semantic search saved. Cached Cineosis candidates downloaded and frame-inspected; titles did not establish pictured event. Apollo-labelled candidates showed lunar/interior views, not verified launch, so NASA dated photographs and PAO source were chosen instead. NASA API metadata and selected original files retained. Search results alone are not claimed watched or licensed.
render: 960×720,30fps,H264/yuv420p,AAC. Original transfer excerpt durations retained; frame duplicate/drop normalization, no motion interpolation or historical camera-speed reconstruction. Crops, freezes, new vector animation and map cameras expressly recorded.
sound: Own source intervals only where declared; new compositions/synthesis explicitly identified. Original source scoring/dubbing not certified synchronous. No actual audio audition or native-speed audiovisual review. Digital-silence claims apply to authored PCM intervals before AAC, not codec-edge leakage.
rights: Underlying cache permission/participant consent not independently audited. NASA and PAO provenance recorded, not a general rights guarantee. Private study exports only; no public publication or external messaging.
